result:
All 617 existing tests pass and the type check is clean. No existing visible tests encoded behavior that this change altered, so none needed updating.

Summary of what was implemented:
- **`src/types/member.ts`**: added `MemberAbsence`.
- **`src/schemas/member.ts`**: added `setAbsenceSchema`/`SetAbsenceInput`.
- **`src/server/db/schema/members.ts`** + **`migrate.ts`**: new `member_absences` table (one row per member, unique on org+user).
- **`src/server/repositories/member-absence-repository.ts`** (new) + **`_mappers.ts`**: CRUD for absences, including `clearDelegate` for cleanup on removal.
- **`src/server/services/member-service.ts`**: `setAbsence`, `clearAbsence`, `getAbsence` (with active-member/delegate validation, self-service vs. `member:update_role`-gated permission, tenant scoping), `resolveDelegate` (single-hop, time-windowed), and `removeMember` now drops the removed member's own absence and clears any delegation pointing at them.
- **`src/server/services/issue-service.ts`**: `createIssue`/`assignIssue` redirect the stored assignee to the delegate when the target is away, except for self-assignment.
- **`src/server/services/notification-service.ts`**: overdue alerts redirect to the delegate; comment mentions alert both the mentioned member and their delegate (deduplicated automatically by `notify`).
